description: The possible states of a Synapse Submission.
name: SubmissionStatusEnum

enum.name: OPEN
enum.description: The submission is open and available for evaluation.

enum.name: CLOSED
enum.description: The submission has been closed and is no longer available for evaluation.

enum.name: SCORED
enum.description: The submission has been evaluated and assigned a score.

enum.name: INVALID
enum.description: The submission is invalid due to errors or not meeting requirements.

enum.name: VALIDATED
enum.description: The submission has passed validation checks.

enum.name: EVALUATION_IN_PROGRESS
enum.description: The submission is currently being evaluated.

enum.name: RECEIVED
enum.description: The submission has been received and is awaiting further processing.

enum.name: REJECTED
enum.description: The submission has been reviewed and rejected.

enum.name: ACCEPTED
enum.description: The submission has been reviewed and accepted.
